title: SparLeak: Privacy Leakage from Sparse Attention in LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2609.38830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse attention is widely used to accelerate long-context inference in modern large language models (LLMs), but its input-dependent execution behavior introduces previously unexplored privacy risks. We identify a new GPU micro-architectural side channel, termed Sparsity-Induced Memory Access (SIMA), which arises from secret-dependent key-value cache access patterns induced by sparse attention.   Based on this observation, we present SparLeak, a phase-aware side-channel attack that extracts SIMA traces during LLM inference and enables two practical privacy extractions: query attribute inference from prefill-phase traces and autoregressive response reconstruction from decoding-phase traces. By reconstructing approximate token-level sparsity profiles from page-level observations and applying profiling-based learning, SparLeak accurately recovers sensitive information, including user-query attributes and private LLM response content. Extens

translated_title: SparLeak：共享GPU上LLM推理中稀疏注意力引发的隐私泄露
translated_abstract: 稀疏注意力被广泛用于加速现代大语言模型（LLM）的长上下文推理，但其依赖输入的执行行为引入了此前未被探索的隐私风险。我们识别出一种新的GPU微架构侧信道，称为稀疏性诱导内存访问（SIMA），它源于稀疏注意力所引发的依赖秘密的键值缓存访问模式。基于这一观察，我们提出了SparLeak，一种相位感知的侧信道攻击，它在LLM推理过程中提取SIMA轨迹，并实现两种实用的隐私提取：从预填充阶段轨迹推断查询属性，以及从解码阶段轨迹重建自回归响应。通过从页面级观测重建近似的令牌级稀疏性轮廓，并应用基于画像特征的学习方法，SparLeak能够准确恢复敏感信息，包括用户查询属性和私密的LLM响应内容。
tldr: 提出了一种利用稀疏注意力引发的GPU内存访问模式侧信道（SIMA）的相位感知攻击SparLeak，能够从共享GPU上的LLM推理中推断用户查询属性并重建私密的模型响应内容。
en_tdlr: SparLeak is a phase-aware GPU side-channel attack exploiting sparsity-induced memory access patterns in sparse attention, enabling inference of user query attributes and reconstruction of private LLM responses on shared GPUs.
